London Borough of Camden is a roleplaying game based in the UK. 

⚠️ Team Killing is Strictly Prohibited
If you intentionally kill teammates, this is considered game abuse and will result in a ban without refund.
By playing this game and purchasing Game Passes, you agree to follow the rules.
Leaving, Resetting or Glitching to avoid arrest is not permitted here and will result in disciplinary action taking place. ⚠️ 

In this game, you can roleplay as a British Police Officer, A Firefighter, a Paramedic / Doctor or even a bus driver here in London Borough of Camden, UK.
